summary: Recover the preserved browser-only Milgam dashboard release by packaging and binding the verified guest SDK, revoking legacy authorization with its session, keeping diagnostics body-free, preserving enabled snapshots and CSP-safe charts, and proving the corrected local-only controller fixture lifecycle before release.
assumptions: Prior application changes are preserved, but prior preview rejection and blocked-batch recovery grant no release approval.
The three supplied current-report Search routes and existing host ready, executeCommand, and ToDisplayDate boundaries remain the only supported browser contracts.
Deployment is controller-owned and outside application implementation; exact-preview and production evidence may be collected only by later authorized stages.

The supplied controller-owned GuestBridge harness is approved for protocol acceptance only when served at the corrected https://milgam.ylm.co.il/controller-host-fixture/ origin with all host/API traffic fulfilled locally and all real tenant traffic blocked.

The earlier https://ylm.ylm.co.il fixture example and resulting frame-ancestor rejection were a controller configuration error, not an application defect; existing trusted origins and CSP must not be widened.

tasks.title: Preserve the authorized live snapshot release configuration
tasks.component: Current snapshot feature boundary and release configuration
tasks.objective: Keep current-report calls enabled for the recovered release candidate and prevent remediation or tests from silently restoring the disabled preview state.
requirements: Set CURRENT_SNAPSHOT_LIVE_CALLS_ENABLED to true in the release-candidate source and keep it true through implementation, tests, exact-preview review, and the one controller-owned production deployment.
Limit the flag to current snapshot calls; preserve analytical loading, authenticated permissions, and date-range behavior.
When enabled, load exactly the three documented Search routes concurrently with body {} and no dates, location filters, pagination, username, or administrator identity.

Do not deploy or call provider/SimplyLog lifecycle APIs from application work. A false local-only revert is permitted only after successful production release under separate authorization and must not trigger deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: Source and deterministic tests assert CURRENT_SNAPSHOT_LIVE_CALLS_ENABLED is true for this release candidate.
A verified host context starts the snapshot lifecycle; a rejected context produces zero authenticated current-report calls.
Changing analytical year/month produces zero current-report calls and does not clear the snapshot.
No implementation or test step resets the flag to false before controller release completion.
validationScenarios: Inspect release-candidate configuration and run a regression that fails when the flag is false.
Accept a valid synthetic bound capability and assert one request to each exact route with body {}; exercise rejected/direct contexts and assert zero requests.
Change periods after snapshot readiness and assert snapshot values, timestamp, and request count remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Render analytical charts under the enforced CSP
tasks.component: Donut, swatch, stacked-bar, bar-chart presentation and CSP headers
tasks.objective: Replace CSP-blocked runtime inline styles with a finite local presentation system while keeping strict response headers, accurate accessible values, and the existing visual hierarchy.
requirements: Remove generated inline style attributes/properties for donut gradients, legend swatches, stacked widths, and bar widths.
Use reviewed same-origin CSS classes, quantized classes, or CSP-compatible SVG presentation without runtime code injection or remote dependencies.
Preserve exact textual values and accessible names even if visual magnitudes use finite quantization; meaning must not depend on color alone.

Keep response-header CSP at least default-src self, script-src self, style-src self, object-src none, and base-uri none; do not add unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, wildcard script sources, or a global bypass.
Preserve responsive Hebrew RTL and runtime LTR layout, visible focus, chart semantics, and analytical date behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The rendered DOM contains no inline style used by the affected chart visuals and requires no relaxation of style-src self.
Division donut, all swatches, stacked segments, and bars are visibly rendered for zero, single-category, mixed, and maximum fixtures.
Accessible labels expose exact counts/percentages and distinguish categories independently of color.
An enforcing preview emits zero relevant CSP style violations and makes zero third-party executable requests.
validationScenarios: Render representative analytical fixtures, inspect DOM/style sources, and assert no affected inline style attributes exist.
Capture desktop and mobile RTL plus LTR regression views and verify visible donut, swatches, stacks, bars, exact labels, no clipping, and coherent focus order.
Inspect exact-preview response headers, console, and executable network requests; assert strict CSP, no relevant violation, and same-origin execution only.

tasks.title: Bind the verified guest SDK and protect regressions
tasks.component: Guest SDK bootstrap, adapters, capability lifecycle, diagnostics, state orchestration, and deterministic suites
tasks.objective: Package the supplied verified guest SDK, make its private session the authority for commands and authorization lifetime, remove API response bodies from diagnostics, and rerun deterministic coverage without weakening accepted contracts.
requirements: Validate event scope cardinality/reconciliation, separate permit metrics, raw report-date delegation, and explicit loading, empty, initial-error, retry, refresh-error, and stale states without fabricated zeros.

Deduplicate identical equipment facts by EquipmentId before unique population reconciliation; reject conflicting duplicates, malformed rows, and incomplete populations, and keep classification unavailable.

Accept authenticated contexts only through verified parent source, approved HTTPS parent/API origins, immutable values, and a private non-forgeable capability brand; public markers or booleans are insufficient.

Package the controller-supplied hash-recorded SimplyVibeClient as a same-origin dependency, instantiate it with the exact trusted parent origin, and bind host services to that private instance; remove reliance on globalThis.SimplyVibeHostAdapter or any test-injected adapter.

Treat SDK session reset, disposal, timeout, replacement, or disconnect as revocation of the matching application capability: abort its requests, invalidate pending commands, deny new authenticated effects, and require a fresh verified SDK generation for re-entry.

Bind requests, date responses, and commands to capability/request generations; revoke/abort on replacement or 401/403, retain last-good stale data, ignore late results, and require fresh verified re-entry.

Limit browser diagnostics to bounded metadata such as dataset, status, kind, byte count, and item count; never log or retain raw/parsed API bodies, snippets, personal/internal fields, credentials, or full serialized request errors.
Preserve exact permit Navigate payload, single-flight activation, safe focus restoration, keyboard access, RTL/LTR semantics, current charts, permissions, and analytical date behavior.
Use synthetic non-secret fixtures and keep all tests local and deterministic; do not weaken existing assertions.
acceptanceCriteria: All focused UAT, QC, and existing regression suites pass with the live snapshot flag true.

The production guest loads the verified same-origin client, performs the real Ready handshake, and sends the exact Navigate command through GuestBridge without an injected adapter or public host-service global.
Revoking the faithful harness session makes the legacy context unusable: a refresh sends zero old-token requests, pending work has zero late effects, and fresh re-entry is the only recovery path.
Synthetic HTTP/invalid-response bodies containing distinctive personal/internal markers are absent from console output and error serialization while safe metadata remains observable.

Tests fail for a forged host-shaped object, altered snapshot request body, conflicting equipment duplicate, stale-generation commit, fabricated zero, parameterized permit URL, unsafe focus cleanup, or affected inline chart style.
A 10,000-row equipment fixture maps/deduplicates within 100 ms after warm-up on the recorded runtime and produces no equipment fact-list DOM growth.
A 10-refresh burst commits only generation 10, and 20 rapid permit activations yield one pending command chain.
validationScenarios: Run focused API/adapter/state/host/UI tests and the full existing regression suite; record commands, runtime, totals, failures, and skips.
Exercise zero, one, 1,000, 10,000, duplicate-heavy, nullable, conflicting, and malformed equipment fixtures and record decoded bytes and mapping durations.
Run the negative trust matrix plus revoke/re-entry simulations, reverse-order stale responses, refresh bursts, permit bursts, removed/rerendered focus targets, and analytical period changes.

Run SDK bootstrap/integrity tests against the supplied verified client and GuestBridge: no injected adapter, exact origin, Ready correlation, session rotation/disposal, command single-flight, and generation-bound results.
Return synthetic HTTP and malformed bodies with unique sensitive markers, capture console/error output, and assert none of the markers or body snippets are exposed.
Inspect fixtures and output for credentials, raw event text, signed URLs, or weakened assertions.

tasks.title: Verify the exact enabled preview
tasks.component: Exact-preview browser acceptance, responsive behavior, CSP, and performance evidence
tasks.objective: Demonstrate in the corrected controller-owned fixture that the exact artifact packages the real guest command path, enables current snapshots, keeps diagnostics body-free, and meets visual, interaction, network, and performance requirements.
requirements: Serve the controller fixture only at https://milgam.ylm.co.il/controller-host-fixture/, fulfill host/API traffic locally with non-secret fixtures, block real tenant traffic, and load the exact release-candidate preview with the live snapshot flag true.
Do not add https://ylm.ylm.co.il to frame-ancestors or trusted origins; the earlier failing origin was a corrected controller-fixture mistake.
Exercise all three current routes, permit navigation, independent period changes, loading/error/stale/retry states, and existing analytical workflows.
Verify 390×844 and 1440×900 in RTL and LTR, keyboard flow, focus visibility, announcements, chart visibility, horizontal overflow, and console/page errors.
Measure three-request concurrency, decoded bytes, 10,000-row mapping/rendering, snapshot DOM count, 10-refresh behavior, and 20-activation command behavior.
Capture CSP response headers and executable network URLs; no third-party executable or relevant CSP violation is allowed.
Inject distinctive personal/internal markers into synthetic error bodies and capture the browser console; no body field, snippet, credential, or full error object may be emitted.
acceptanceCriteria: The preview shows current event, permit, and equipment-total data rather than a disabled state and issues exactly three current requests per load/refresh.

SimplyVibeClient is packaged and initialized from same-origin assets, both permit controls produce exactly Navigate with {Url: '#/Permits/Dashboard'} through GuestBridge, and 20 rapid activations produce one pending command chain.
API failure console output contains safe metadata only and none of the synthetic response-body markers.
All affected charts are visible at both viewports with zero relevant CSP console errors, no uncaught exception, and no third-party executable request.
The ready snapshot contains at most 80 DOM elements and renders within 50 ms at both viewports; 10,000 rows map within 100 ms on the recorded runtime.
Snapshot state remains independent of analytical dates; refresh and permit bursts obey generation and single-flight limits.
validationScenarios: Run enabled snapshot happy path, initial failure/retry, stale refresh failure, analytical period change, and exact permit navigation through the real packaged SDK in the preview.
Record screenshots and accessibility/keyboard observations at both viewports in RTL and LTR, including all affected charts.
Record browser/runtime versions, response headers, console/page errors, executable requests, route/request counts, bytes, timings, nodes, refresh winner, and command count.

tasks.title: Prove authorization lifecycle and hand off release
tasks.component: Approved host lifecycle acceptance and controller-owned release evidence
tasks.objective: Close the authorization lifecycle gate with the supplied faithful controller harness at its corrected local-only origin and provide truthful evidence for controller release and any later local-only flag revert.
requirements: Use the supplied controller-owned GuestBridge harness at https://milgam.ylm.co.il/controller-host-fixture/ with locally fulfilled traffic only; synthetic injected adapters and unapproved parent messaging cannot satisfy this gate.
Preserve the existing trusted-origin and frame-ancestor policy; do not authorize the mistaken https://ylm.ylm.co.il origin and do not contact a real tenant.
Revoke or expire authorization during snapshot/analytical requests and during a permit command; verify abort/denial, stale retention, and zero old-generation effects.
Provide fresh verified authorization and prove a new capability generation recovers data and accepts only correctly bound command responses.
Keep the live-call flag true through the single controller-owned production deployment; application work must not deploy or invoke lifecycle/provider APIs.

If the approved environment is unavailable, report the exact gate blocked/skipped and do not claim release approval. Any post-release false revert is separately authorized, local-only, and not deployed.
acceptanceCriteria: Old-generation late API and command responses cause zero UI, network, navigation, or state effects after revocation.
Last-good values remain visible as stale while new authenticated work is denied until fresh verified re-entry.
Fresh authorization creates a new generation, restores current and analytical data, and rejects mismatched command responses.
Harness disconnect/session rotation revokes the legacy JSON context so post-revocation refresh and command attempts produce zero old-token requests or bridge effects.
Release evidence clearly separates local tests, exact-preview results, approved-host lifecycle results, controller deployment status, and any skipped check; no unsupported approval claim is made.
validationScenarios: Begin concurrent requests, revoke before settlement, resolve old responses, and assert abort plus zero commit; attempt further requests and assert denial.
Begin permit navigation, revoke before response, return an old or mismatched response, and assert no navigation; re-enter freshly and prove the exact command succeeds only for the new generation.
Review the release record for enabled-flag evidence through production, controller-owned deployment provenance, honest skipped/blocking reasons, and no deployment of a later local false revert.
